description: Takes the vector a Tricorder is graphing out to ports, and goes immediately to the right of it

params.text: Scales the output vector by a factor of 0 to 16, marked from minus infinity dB to +24dB, with 0dB leaving it unchanged
Attenuates and inverts the level CV
Adds a Tricorder to the left, which feeds this module the vector it is graphing

inputs.text: Varies the scaling applied to the output vector

outputs.text: The x component of the received vector, scaled by LEVEL
The y component of the received vector, scaled by LEVEL
The z component of the received vector, scaled by LEVEL
A copy of the trigger that asked the Tricorder on the left to clear its display
The received vector as a 3-channel polyphonic signal, x on channel 1, y on channel 2 and z on channel 3

notes: the level-adjusted vector is also passed on to any module immediately to the right, so several of these can be chained
this module has no ports of its own to feed: place it immediately to the right of a Tricorder, and the vector that Tricorder is graphing comes out of its ports.
menu: Insert Tricorder on right — adds a Tricorder to the right, which plots the outgoing vector in 3D
Low sensitivity — on an attenuverter knob's own menu, not the panel menu: divides that knob's effect by 10 and marks the knob with an orange dot
Unipolar mode — on an attenuverter knob's own menu, not the panel menu: adds 5V to the CV on that control and clamps the result at zero

inputs.0:
continuous · polyphonic

a negative voltage subtracts from the knob; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to ±5V.
